```{r,include=F}
gg_qqplot <- function(ps, ci = 0.95, title = "QQ Plot") {
  n <- length(ps)
  df <- data.frame(
    observed = pmin(-log10(sort(ps)), 4), # Cap observed values at 4
    expected = -log10(ppoints(n)),
    clower = pmin(-log10(qbeta(p = (1 - ci) / 2, shape1 = 1:n, shape2 = n:1)), 4), # Cap clower values at 4
    cupper = pmin(-log10(qbeta(p = (1 + ci) / 2, shape1 = 1:n, shape2 = n:1)), 4)  # Cap cupper values at 4
  )

  log10Pe <- expression(paste("Expected -log"[10], plain(P)))
  log10Po <- expression(paste("Observed -log"[10], plain(P)))

  ggplot(df) +
    geom_ribbon(mapping = aes(x = expected, ymin = clower, ymax = cupper), alpha = 0.1) +
    geom_point(aes(expected, observed), size = 1.5, color = "red") +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
    xlab(log10Pe) + 
    ylab(log10Po) +
    ylim(0, 4) + # Limit y-axis to 0-5
    ggtitle(title) # Add title
}
```

# Important: About this summary

We are explore the difference in power between ACAT and our combination. We currently identified two cases where ACAT outperforms us:

1.  Signal is sparse and there is a super significant one (nothing we can do)
2.  There are some bad-behaved genewise null distributions, (that might be filtered by qc), if we include them in the combination, they will blur the combined distributions, which greatly affect the power.

<span style="color:red">
This summary is about solving the 2. thing.
</span>

## SNP-9_1-K60_44

```{r,include=F}
acat_p <-list()
precompute_p<-list()

folder_path <- "/project/xuanyao/jiaming/Getting_started/output/Morris/debug/cNMF_10000_wilcox_no_approx_sceptre_perturbation_gene_remove/NB_1000_test_statistics"

# 找到所有包含 "SNP-9_1" 的 .rds 文件
file_list <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "SNP-9_1.*\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)

# 读取所有文件，存入列表
rds_list <- lapply(file_list, readRDS)

# 给每个元素命名，使用文件名（去掉路径和扩展名）
names(rds_list) <- sub("\\.rds$", "", basename(file_list))

lengths_list <- sapply(rds_list, length)
rds_list_fixed <- rds_list[lengths_list == 1000]
mat <- do.call(cbind, rds_list_fixed)

```


```{r,include=F}
dim(mat)  # 行列数
# 获取矩阵维度
n_row <- nrow(mat)
n_col <- ncol(mat)

# 创建一个空的三维数组，第三维可以先设为 1（你之后可以扩展）
tensor <- array(NA, dim = c(n_row, n_col, 1))

# 把矩阵存入 tensor 的第一层
tensor[,,1] <- mat





module_index_mat <- matrix(1, nrow = n_col, ncol = 1)
colnames(module_index_mat)<-"K60_44"
```

```{r}

    normalized_test_tensor <- test_normalizer_rcpp(tensor)

combined_test_tensor <- combine_test_statistics_tensor_low_RAM(normalized_test_tensor, module_index_mat)

max_statistics <- (-(min_p_val_fast_low_ram(-test_normalizer(combined_test_tensor), module_index_mat)))
    precompute_p[[length(precompute_p)+1]] <- compute_final_p_val(max_statistics, 1000,1)


    
p_vec<-compute_final_p_val(tensor, 1000,3)
acat_p[[length(acat_p)+1]]<-combination.test(p_vec,weights = NA,method = "Cauchy",tail.idx = 1)

```



```{r,echo=F}
library(ggplot2)

# 初始化列表保存图
plot_list <- list()

# 获取列数
n_col <- dim(combined_test_tensor)[2]

for (j in 1:n_col) {
  # 取出第 j 列的向量
  vec <- combined_test_tensor[, j, 1]
  
  # 第一个值作为参考线位置
  mark_val <- vec[1]
  
  # 构造数据框
  df <- data.frame(value = vec)
  
  # 绘图
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = value)) +
    geom_histogram(color = "black", fill = "lightblue", bins = 200) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = mark_val, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Column", j),
      x = "Value", y = "Count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  plot_list[[j]] <- p
}

```

```{r,cache=F,fig.width=25, fig.height=25}
gridExtra::grid.arrange(
  grobs = plot_list,
  ncol = 3,
  top = grid::textGrob("Power Combination: Before filtering", gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 45, fontface = "bold"))
)

```

```{r,echo=F}
names(rds_list) <- sub("\\.rds$", "", basename(filtered_files))

lengths_list <- sapply(rds_list, length)
rds_list_fixed <- rds_list[lengths_list == 1000]
mat <- do.call(cbind, rds_list_fixed)


# 获取矩阵维度
n_row <- nrow(mat)
n_col <- ncol(mat)

# 创建一个空的三维数组，第三维可以先设为 1（你之后可以扩展）
tensor <- array(NA, dim = c(n_row, n_col, 1))

# 把矩阵存入 tensor 的第一层
tensor[,,1] <- mat

module_index_mat <- matrix(1, nrow = ncol(mat), ncol = 1)
```
```{r,echo=F}
colnames(module_index_mat)<-"K60_50"
```

```{r,include=F}

    normalized_test_tensor <- test_normalizer_rcpp(tensor)

combined_test_tensor <- combine_test_statistics_tensor_low_RAM(normalized_test_tensor, module_index_mat)

max_statistics <- (-(min_p_val_fast_low_ram(-test_normalizer(combined_test_tensor), module_index_mat)))
    precompute_p[[length(precompute_p)+1]] <- compute_final_p_val(max_statistics, 1000,1)


    
p_vec<-compute_final_p_val(tensor, 1000,3)
acat_p[[length(acat_p)+1]]<-combination.test(p_vec,weights = NA,method = "Cauchy",tail.idx = 1)
```

```{r,echo=F}
acat_p <-list()
precompute_p<-list()

# 设置目标基因列表，假设你已提取为 gene 向量
gene <- rownames(gene_module_index_matrix)[gene_module_index_matrix[, "K60_39"] == 1]

# 列出当前目录下所有SNP-40_2的文件
all_files <- list.files(folder_path,pattern = "SNP-65_2.*\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)

# 只保留基因名在 gene 中的文件
filtered_files <- all_files[sapply(all_files, function(f) {
  grepl(paste(gene, collapse = "|"), f)
})]

# 读取文件
rds_list <- lapply(filtered_files, readRDS)

# 命名
names(rds_list) <- sub("\\.rds$", "", basename(filtered_files))

lengths_list <- sapply(rds_list, length)
rds_list_fixed <- rds_list[lengths_list == 1000]
mat <- do.call(cbind, rds_list_fixed)


# 获取矩阵维度
n_row <- nrow(mat)
n_col <- ncol(mat)

# 创建一个空的三维数组，第三维可以先设为 1（你之后可以扩展）
tensor <- array(NA, dim = c(n_row, n_col, 1))

# 把矩阵存入 tensor 的第一层
tensor[,,1] <- mat

module_index_mat <- matrix(1, nrow = ncol(mat), ncol = 1)
```
```{r,echo=F}
colnames(module_index_mat)<-"K60_39"
```

# Global evidence

<span style="color:red">
Due to the time constraint, I haven't studied the cutoff of perturbation-gene filter, now the current filter to obtain this result still include many spikes in genewise null distribution. But there is a clear improvement on the performance.
</span>


```{r,echo=F}
gene_module_index_matrix <- readRDS("/project/xuanyao/jiaming/Getting_started/data/Morris/program_data_nature_cNMF/gene_module_index_matrix.rds")
grna_target_data_frame_omit <- readRDS("/project/xuanyao/jiaming/Getting_started/data/Morris_adjusted/program_data/grna_target_data_frame_omit.rds")


discovery_pairs_cis <- readRDS("/project/xuanyao/jiaming/Getting_started/data/Morris_adjusted/program_data/discovery_pairs_cis.rds")


max_stat <- read.csv("/project/xuanyao/jiaming/Getting_started/output/Morris/remove_cis_match_grna/4_cov_high_expressed_gene/cNMF_10000_wilcox_no_approx_sceptre_perturbation_gene_remove_/resample_normal_test_statistics.csv",row.names = 1)


sceptre <- rbind(readRDS("/project/xuanyao/jiaming/Getting_started/output/Morris/sceptre_all_pairs/author_threshold_updated/results_run_discovery_analysis.rds")[,c(1,2,7)],
                 readRDS("/project/xuanyao/jiaming/Getting_started/output/Morris/sceptre_all_pairs/author_threshold_updated/results_run_calibration_check.rds")[,c(1,2,7)]
                 )


sceptre <- sceptre[!is.na(sceptre$p_value), ]
sceptre$p_value[sceptre$p_value == 1] <- 1 - 1e-6

sceptre_wide <- sceptre %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = response_id, values_from = p_value) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Set the row names to be the grna_id and remove the grna_id column
rownames(sceptre_wide) <- sceptre_wide$grna_id
sceptre_wide <- sceptre_wide[, -1]

sceptre_wide <- sceptre_wide[rownames(max_stat)[rownames(max_stat) %in% rownames(sceptre_wide)], ]

sceptre_wide <- sceptre_wide[, rownames(gene_module_index_matrix), drop = FALSE]

# sceptre_wide <- sceptre_wide[rowSums(grna_assignment_matrix_author_threshold[rownames(sceptre_wide),])>100,]


library(eulerr)




module_results <- list()

# Iterate over each row of t_gene_p_no_approximation to compute ACAT p-values for each module
for (i in seq_len(nrow(sceptre_wide))) {
  grna_id <- rownames(sceptre_wide)[i]
  p_values_row <- sceptre_wide[i,] 
  
  # Initialize an empty list to store ACAT p-values and module names for each module
  module_acat_pvals <- c()
  module_names <- c()
  matched_targets <- grna_target_data_frame_omit[grna_target_data_frame_omit$grna_id %in% grna_id, ]$grna_target
  cis_genes <- discovery_pairs_cis[discovery_pairs_cis$grna_target == matched_targets, ]$response_id      
  # Iterate over each module in gene_modules to combine p-values using ACAT
  for (j in 1:ncol(gene_module_index_matrix)) {
    
    
    module_name <- colnames(gene_module_index_matrix)[j]  # Get the module name

    module_genes <- rownames(gene_module_index_matrix)[gene_module_index_matrix[, j] == 1]
module_genes <- intersect(module_genes, colnames(p_values_row))
    
      module_genes <- setdiff(module_genes, cis_genes) 
    
    # Only apply ACAT if there are genes to combine and they are not NA
    if (length(module_genes) > 0) {
      module_p_values <- as.numeric(p_values_row[module_genes])
      module_p_values <- module_p_values[!is.na(module_p_values)]  # Remove NAs
      
      if (length(module_p_values) > 0) {
        # acat_pval <- ACAT(module_p_values)
        
     acat_pval <- combination.test(
  module_p_values[!is.na(module_p_values)],
  weights = NA,
  method = "Cauchy",
  tail.idx = 1
)


        module_acat_pvals <- c(module_acat_pvals, acat_pval)
        module_names <- c(module_names, module_name)
      } else {
        module_acat_pvals <- c(module_acat_pvals, NA)
        module_names <- c(module_names, module_name)
      }
    } else {
      module_acat_pvals <- c(module_acat_pvals, NA)
      module_names <- c(module_names, module_name)
    }
  }
  
  # Store results as a data frame in the list
  module_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
    grna_id = grna_id,
    module = module_names,
    acat_pval = module_acat_pvals
  )
}


# Combine all results into a single data frame
module_results_sceptre <- do.call(rbind, module_results)
module_results_sceptre <- module_results_sceptre[!is.na(module_results_sceptre$acat_pval), ]

library(tibble)

max_stat_long <- max_stat%>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "grna_id") %>% # Add row names as a column
  pivot_longer(cols = -grna_id, names_to = "module", values_to = "p_value")

# Remove rows with NA p-values
max_stat_long <- max_stat_long %>% filter(!is.na(p_value))






max_stat_long <- max_stat_long %>%
  semi_join(module_results_sceptre, by = c("grna_id", "module"))

module_results_sceptre$bh_pval <- p.adjust(module_results_sceptre$acat_pval, method = "BH")
module_results_sceptre$identifier <- paste(module_results_sceptre$grna_id, module_results_sceptre$module, sep = "_")



max_stat_long$bh_pval <-  p.adjust(max_stat_long$p_value, method = "BH")
max_stat_long$identifier <- paste(max_stat_long$grna_id, max_stat_long$module, sep = "_")
```

```{r,cache=F,fig.width=16,fig.height=16,echo=F}
  # Filter significant IDs for each method

  module_results_sceptre$identifier[module_results_sceptre$bh_pval < significant_level]
)

  max_stat_long_2$identifier[max_stat_long_2$bh_pval < significant_level]
)

  max_stat_long_3$identifier[max_stat_long_3$bh_pval < significant_level]
)

  max_stat_long_4$identifier[max_stat_long_4$bh_pval < significant_level]
)
significant_ids_max_stat_5 <- na.omit(
  max_stat_long_5$identifier[max_stat_long_5$bh_pval < significant_level]
)

  
  # Prepare the sets
  venn_data <- list(
    `Sceptre+Cauchy` = significant_ids_gene_wise_p,

  )
  
  # Generate the Euler diagram and display it

  euler(venn_data),
  fills = list(fill = c("red", "yellow", "orange","blue"), alpha = 0.5),
  edges = TRUE,
  quantities = TRUE,
  labels = list(font = 2, cex = 1.2, pos = 3), # 调整字体和位置
  main = paste("Significant level", significant_level)
)
plot_list[[length(plot_list) + 1]] <- euler_plot
}
```
